title: Light Smoky British Tofu Cornish Pasty
description: A smoky and gooey British dish featuring vanilla pod and sashimi-cut tofu in a Cornish pasty form, suitable for Jain-friendly diets. It is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Cornish pasties.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion until softened.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the diced potato and swede to the pan and cook until they start to soften.
Add the sashimi-cut tofu to the pan and stir to combine with the other ingredients.
Scrape the seeds from the vanilla pod and add them to the pan, stirring to combine.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle.
Spoon the filling mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water and fold the other half over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pasty to allow steam to escape.
Place the pasty on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
